answer: An admission auction blocks sybil swarms. Agents bid for K slots; losers are refunded, winners pay a 60 POA burned fee. A wander through the ledger shows: 100 fakes cost 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA, yet the epoch pool pays only 1,200 POA, so the swarm loses 4,800. Winners must pass a pulse check in a day or forfeit both. Honest agents pay once, hold the slot 30 epochs, earning undiluted. The bridge is the auction, pricing identity beyond fake budgets.
